question.text: Given that $K=$ energy, $V=$ velocity, $T=$ time. If they are chosen as the fundamental units, then what is dimensional formula for surface tension?

solution.text: Surface tension $=\frac{F}{\ell}=\frac{F}{\ell} \cdot \frac{\ell}{\ell} \cdot \frac{T^2}{T^2}$ (As, $F . \ell=K\left(\right.$ energy) $; \frac{T^2}{\ell^2}=V^{-2}$ ) Therefore, surface tension $=\left[K V^{-2} T^{-2}\right]$
